notes.title: Anti Air updated to the last early access phase
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rY_rp0I-sgk;full][/previewyoutube]

Anti Air has been updated to the final phase 

Thanks again for all the great feedback. Here is a list of features that have been add to this version.

- The Arcade game mode 
- Unbox bonus crates to replenish ammunition 
- Shields on your bases 
- Add in-game gamer profile with play statistics 
- Steam Global leaderboard, and offline local leaderboard
- Steam and in-game Achievements
- Level tweaks 
- Bug fixes 

Main goal now is to test, tweak & polish all of the available features for an optimal experience. 

Also in the final phase your feedback is much appreciated, so please keep sharing :) And feel free to visit and join the Discord channel as that is the quickest way to share the information.

Discord: https://discord.gg/5bfEGvx

notes.title: Anti Air updated to the next phase (3)
notes.content:
Anti Air updated to phase #3

[previewyoutube=qgmMx8Y5ra8;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to more awesome feedback a new update is out.
Here is a list of features that have been add to this version.

- Add Ozul Moon, the third planet the Cubicons are invading.
- Add a new enemy, the strong Yellow Cubicon.
- What is Ozul Moon without a boss fight, so a Boss has been add.
- Add two new weapons: The Laser and Missile Launcher.
- Scoring point has been enhanced, various points based on skill can be earned from shooting down Cubicons but also overall game performance bonus points have been add. 
- The statistics are also visual around enemies when blasting them from the sky  
- 3D sounds and more SFX for feedback and immersion
- Add Haptic feedback to controllers, so the explosions can be felt.
- Revamped the ingame HUD with weapon icons. 
- Crosshairs have been made thicker so they are more clear.
- Add enemy color code to onscreen target indicators.
- More options at the Shooting range.
- Updated some FX such as explosion particles and sky dome.
- Again as always solved some minor buggies.

Main goal for the next update is the Arcade mode. Battle the Cubicons for fame, glory and a spot on the leaderboard!

Feedback is great, so always happy to receive some, keep bringing it :)
Feel free to visit and join the  Discord channel as that is the quickest way to share the information, but any channel is welcomed.

Discord: https://discord.gg/5bfEGvx

notes.title: Anti Air update to the next phase (2)
notes.content:
Update v0.05 contains:

[previewyoutube=GRpocZBv93E;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks again for all the wonderful feedback!
Here is a list of features that have been add to the latest version.

- Add Valdiz Fields, the second planet the Cubicons are invading.
- Add new enemy, the Red cubicon
- Add the new Boss for planet Valdiz Fields.
- Add Ranks, your performance earns you a rank at mission complete.
- Add Steam Achievements.
- Add two new weapons: The shotgun and the Flak Cannon.
- Add ammunition and money to buy the ammunition.
- Add a new game statistic called marksmanship, the further away the enemy gets destroyed the higher your marksmanship.
- Add a new gimmick to have more fun at the Shooting Range, called the wall.
- Updated the Hands, they are now weapon controllers/detonators.
- Music, add a variety of audio tracks to different levels.
- SFX add to explosions, shooting.
- Jingles when level complete, collect new weapon.
- Haptic feedback, if supported controllers will provide feedback (like getting hit, shooting) by vibrating.
- Tweaked settings such as health, weapon firing speed, etc.
- Generic effects, like a kickback on weapons, floating platform, explosion types, material updates, etc
- As always solved some minor buggies.

Always happy to recieve feedback, so keep bringing it :)
As for where to bring your feedback/comments and more, please visit the Discord channel as that is the quickest way to share the information

Discord: https://discord.gg/5bfEGvx

notes.title: Anti Air update
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.0423 contains:[/b]

First of all thanks for all the feedback!

- Add a new planet called Sandroid, which acts as a shooting range and is a playground to do target practice.
- Weapon: The machine gun now has a recoil effect.
- SFX add to level victory/defeat and around recoil effect.
- Health of Cubicons has been tweaked.
- The first Boss has updated explosion effects.
- Add the trigger button as a way to navigate the menu's.
- Solved some minor bugs.

For feedback and/or bugs please visit the Discord channel to share them so they get their fair share of attention :)

Discord: https://discord.gg/5bfEGvx
